# [BIG ANNOUNCEMENT / 重大告知] Initial I: Racing for the Fastest & ANNOUNCEMENTS #5thAnniversaRyS

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- IRyS dramatically announced her first solo concert, 'Hope Symbol BEYOND THE STARS,' scheduled for October 6th in Tokyo, after overcoming a series of challenges.
- The stream featured a three-game challenge testing precision, spatial awareness, and speed, including car curling, a blindfolded navigation game, and a car race time attack.
- Key concert details were revealed, such as the new venue, lottery-based ticket system with various tiers, and the availability of streaming tickets with extended archive access.
- IRyS announced the digital release of her album on July 12th and the immediate premiere of the music video for her track 'Muse' after the stream.
- The event concluded with heartfelt 5th-anniversary congratulations from fellow VTubers and IRyS's commitment to delivering an unforgettable live performance.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:01:46](#t=00:01:46) Three-Game Challenge Issued**: A group of challengers, including Nerissa Ravencroft, block IRyS's announcement and propose a three-game contest to prove her skills, with the announcement as the prize.
- **[⏱️ 00:15:00](#t=00:15:00) IRyS Solo Concert Announcement**: IRyS makes a dramatic and emotional announcement of her first solo concert, 'Hope Symbol BEYOND THE STARS,' scheduled for October 6th in Tokyo.
- **[⏱️ 00:22:27](#t=00:22:27) IRyS Struggles in Mini-Game**: During her turn in the 'Spatial Awareness Battle,' IRyS struggles with directions, goes the wrong way, and eventually 'crashes,' failing the first round.
- **[⏱️ 00:32:50](#t=00:32:50) Streaming Ticket Benefits**: The hosts explain that streaming tickets offer a month-long archive access, allowing viewers to rewatch the concert multiple times to appreciate outfits and specific moments.
- **[⏱️ 00:36:50](#t=00:36:50) Car Race Time Attack Reveal**: The 'final showdown' challenge is officially announced as a car race time attack, where participants will compete to achieve the fastest lap time on a designated track.
- **[⏱️ 00:53:14](#t=00:53:14) Proclaiming the Drift Queen**: After successfully executing an impressive drift, IRyS is loudly declared the 'DRIFT QUEEN' by the other VTubers.
- **[⏱️ 01:02:14](#t=01:02:14) Album Digital Release & 'Muse' MV Premiere**: IRyS announces the digital release of her pre-ordered album on July 12th at 12 a.m. GST, followed immediately after the stream by the premiere of the music video for 'Muse,' a track from the album.
- **[⏱️ 01:04:47](#t=01:04:47) 5th Anniversary Congratulations**: Other VTubers offer emotional congratulations to IRyS on her 5th anniversary, stating, '5 years is a really long time...I'm so proud of you. You did so good and you're going to do so great at your life. Happy fifth anniversary.'

## ⏱️ Timeline Breakdown
- **[⏱️ 00:00:29](#t=00:00:29)**: The segment begins with IRyS attempting to announce the details for her solo concert scheduled for October 6th. Her announcement is dramatically interrupted by a group of challengers, who block her road with a luxury car. One of the challengers jokingly proclaims, 'I'm Hocus,' while Nerissa Ravencroft asserts that IRyS cannot make announcements so easily on her own channel. They challenge IRyS to a three-game contest testing her precision, spatial awareness, and speed; if she wins, she earns the right to make her concert announcement. IRyS confidently accepts the challenge. The first game introduced is 'complete control car curling,' a unique variation of curling where players slide toy cars instead of stones. The rules are explained: points are awarded for hitting target rings (1-3 points), players can strategically bump opponent's cars, and IRyS gets three throws against the challengers' one each. Before the game starts, a humorous and lengthy debate ensues over the proper way to play 'Rock, Paper, Scissors' to decide who goes first. Eventually, it's decided that the loser goes first, granting an initial disadvantage. The challenger team takes their turns, struggling at times to keep their cars on the board. IRyS then makes her strategic throws. Despite the competitive play, the first round of the car curling game ultimately concludes in a tie.
- **[⏱️ 00:15:00](#t=00:15:00)**: The segment begins with IRyS dramatically announcing her first solo concert, 'Hope Symbol BEYOND THE STARS,' scheduled for October 6th at SGC Hall Ayak in Tokyo. She excitedly discusses the concert's key visual, which features a demon-motif outfit, noting that her favorite parts are the beret and the rare inclusion of pants for her character. Following the concert announcement, IRyS introduces a new mini-game for the stream called the 'Spatial Awareness Battle.' In this game, participants are blindfolded and must navigate a course to a goal using only verbal distance cues (e.g., 'X feet forward, Y feet to the left/right') and their pre-measured stride lengths, requiring complex mental math. The stride lengths of the participants are revealed: IRyS at 2.3 ft, another at 2.4 ft, one at 1.95 ft, and another at 2.7 ft. The first round of the game sees IRyS attempting to follow directions to go 18 ft forward and 1.87 ft to the left, but she quickly becomes disoriented, going the wrong direction and crashing. It's then revealed that the winner of each round gets to place obstacles for the next. The segment concludes as the next two players prepare for their turn, receiving safety warnings and initial, then corrected, navigation instructions (15 ft forward and 9.61 ft to the right, after a typo was caught).
- **[⏱️ 00:30:00](#t=00:30:00)**: The segment opens with participants, including IRyS, engaged in a physically demanding activity, with one individual expressing fatigue and commenting on the fast pace. This leads into a significant announcement regarding an upcoming event. Details are shared about a brand new, visually appealing venue designed for optimal stage viewing, a lottery-based ticket system with various tiers (SS, S, and A), and the availability of streaming tickets. The benefits of streaming tickets are highlighted, particularly the month-long archive access, allowing viewers to rewatch the concert to appreciate details like outfits. The hosts emphasize enjoying the concert whether attending in-person or streaming. After confirming IRyS's successful completion of her task, the stream transitions to introducing the 'final showdown' challenge: a car race time attack. Before fully detailing the rules, a participant, likely IRyS, discusses her experience of getting a 'stitch' (side cramp), sparking a humorous conversation about the Australian term for it and the complexities of hydration. This discussion also includes a funny moment about sweat being a 'beauty product'. The car race rules are then explained: participants receive one attempt, but IRyS is granted three tries, to complete a single lap as quickly as possible. The course includes obstacles like tires, poles, and elements at the final goal, each incurring specific time penalties. Despite some initial apprehension and humorous banter about driving experience and revving high RPMs, the hosts express excitement for the challenge, especially considering IRyS's multiple attempts to strategize and perfect her run.
- **[⏱️ 00:45:00](#t=00:45:00)**: This segment continues with the VTubers engaging in a driving game challenge. IRyS takes her second turn, attempting to drive faster but ultimately crashing, leading to a slower time and a humorous discussion about the "power of a license" and the necessity of real driving school over video game experience. Another participant then takes their turn, driving cautiously. IRyS is later challenged to demonstrate her "drift queen" title by executing a drift. She performs a "beautiful drift," which, despite leading to a slower overall time, impresses the other VTubers so much that they declare her the winner of that round. Following this, the stream transitions to an anticipated announcement regarding new concert merchandise. The VTubers showcase the "essentials pack," detailing a unique light stick with a gemstone and flower design, and a stylish t-shirt featuring the concert logo and dates, encouraging fans to purchase them as keepsakes.
- **[⏱️ 01:00:01](#t=01:00:01)**: This segment provided critical updates and celebrations around IRyS's upcoming first solo live concert and her recent music releases. It began with a detailed explanation of concert merchandise, distinguishing between advanced shipping items (arriving before the concert) and made-to-order items (arriving afterward), directing viewers to the official shop and to search for 'IRyS's first concert' for more details. IRyS clarified that this merchandise was specifically for the solo live concert, not anniversary merch, which would be released later in the year. A major announcement followed: an album, previously available for pre-order in March, would see its digital release on July 12th at 12 AM GST (midnight that night). Furthermore, immediately after the stream, the music video for 'Muse,' a track from the album, was scheduled to be released, described by IRyS as 'filled with lots of love and care.' The latter half of the segment transitioned into heartfelt 5th-anniversary congratulations from fellow VTubers (referred to as 'kohai' and 'senpai'), who expressed immense pride in IRyS's achievements and acknowledged her journey. IRyS concluded by thanking her colleagues and reiterating her commitment to diligently practice and deliver an 'amazing unforgettable live' concert, encouraging fans to secure tickets for either the streaming or physical venue experience.
